item.title: Gift of Appriciation
item.description: Presenter Poppa Roy Randall was presented with a Certificate of Appreciation for 5 years as a volunteer at the PRH. The certificate was presented by Dr George Findlay Chief Executive of the Trust at the Volunteer Christmas Lunch organised by volunteer coordinator Julie Wiseman at the Birch Hotel in Haywards Heath.

item.title: Thank you! From MDR
item.description: A huge thank you to Nick and the electrical team at the Lindfield Repair café for repairing the MDR Studio fan for a donation .. We even made it to the Hall of Fame board drawn by the talented Polly!

item.title: RIP Dc Rogers.
item.description: It is with great sadness that we announce the passing of our fellow Mid Downs Radio presenter and friend DC Rogers. For nearly 20 years DC has been a firm and popular fixture in the MDR Schedule with his rock themed show……Status Quo was a particular favourite of his…...as well as hosting the ‘Sounds Of The 50s’ show. item.title: Our new patron David Hentschel
item.description: We are delighted to welcome David Hentschel as the new Patron of Mid Downs Hospital Radio.David has a distinguished reputation in the music world and is well known as a music producer and film score composer having produced albums for Genesis, Elton John, George Harrison and Queen among many others .
